html:
Nayib Bukele is the president of El Salvador, first elected in 2019 and re-elected in 2024. He is known for his crackdown on gangs and for making bitcoin legal tender.

A former mayor of San Salvador, he broke the hold of the two parties that had ruled since the peace accords, ARENA and the FMLN. In 2021 his supporters in congress replaced the top judges, who then allowed him to run again despite a ban on re-election. His state of emergency from 2022 jailed tens of thousands suspected of belonging to gangs such as MS-13, and murders fell to a fraction of their former level.

He became very popular at home and a model for leaders elsewhere, while rights groups warned of the end of checks on power in El Salvador. In 2021 it became the first country to make bitcoin legal tender, a step later scaled back.
